10 Del. C. § 8119

No action for the recovery of damages upon a claim for alleged personal injuries shall be brought after the expiration of 2 years from the date upon which it is claimed that such alleged injuries were sustained.

sections.content: Delaware two-year personal injury limitations.

title: Colo. Rev. Stat. § 7-108-401 — General standards of conduct for directors
content:
Colo. Rev. Stat. § 7-108-401

(1) Each director shall discharge the director's duties as a director:

(a) In good faith;

(b) With the care an ordinarily prudent person in a like position would exercise under similar circumstances; and

(c) In a manner the director reasonably believes to be in the best interests of the corporation.
